mine a current-baseline matched-current corpus for M142 and M156 with at least 100 wrong-history physical pairs per evaluated checkpoint after action-gate filtering
keep wrong-history above-threshold fraction at or above 0.70
keep wrong-history closer-to-right fraction at or above 0.65
preserve source and target diversity in the exported action-intervention rows
state whether the candidate can continue to the remaining M154 stages
failure_criteria: start PPO before the action stage reaches registered coverage
relax the M154 action thresholds after seeing the result
evaluate only M156 without recalibrating M142

decision_rule: Admit the remaining M154 repeat stages only if the broadened current action surface clears coverage, action-distance, and closer-to-right thresholds for both M142 and M156.

result.notes: The top-80 cap remains negative, but the full broadened current zero-relvel surface clears physical-pair coverage, above-threshold action-distance, and closer-to-right thresholds for both M142 and M156. This clears the action-stage blocker only; outcome and strict proof-surface gates are still required before PPO.
